mutations.name: the guard lets a rewrite say an id the original did not
kills: a rewrite that takes an id out of the line is refused when it says an id the original did not

mutations.name: a cited id is held as a term the line must keep saying
kills: a rewrite that takes an id out of the line is accepted when a script id the beat declares leaves

mutations.name: an id's TP lead counts as a dropped entity
kills: a rewrite that takes an id out of the line is accepted when a ticket id leaves, its TP lead included

mutations.name: an id's lead words count as dropped content terms
kills: a rewrite that takes an id out of the line is accepted when a pull request id leaves with its lead words

mutations.name: the guard lets a number the screen shows leave the line
kills: a rewrite that cuts what is not an id is still refused when a number the screen shows leaves the line
